records.name: You fool! Why are you laughing!

records.name: Not on my watch!
findings: Official Bandai Namco anniversary documentation lists the Super Soul among Hercule raid individual-performance rewards.
Current catalogue and later Hercule Lite documentation corroborate +30% all attacks and +30% damage taken for 30 seconds, with Auto Health and Stamina Recovery! DEF Down Limit Burst.

policy: Canonical data remains authoritative; independent evidence is used to reconcile provenance and mechanics, while unresolved fields remain explicitly unresolved.
